June 5, 1990

TO: Mr. Robert Bernstein

SUBJECT: SAMPLING AUDITS

FROM: Mark McGlynn

Bob, the purchase order issued for Newport sampling audits, is for twenty-two dates.

Please add the following dates, to fill in for the two canceled (May 27, 1990 in Milwaukee and Chicago).

DATE	LOCATION	ADDRESS
June 28, 1990	Avenue 64 (Nightclub)	North & Main St. Glendale, IL
June 29, 1990	Jim's Marine Inn (Nightclub)	2630 Gerritson St. Brooklyn, NY

Bob, please have your auditors observe and report all activity taking place in these establishments.

87531682

If you have any questions, please call me.

[SIGNATURE] M. McGlynn

/sc

cc: Mr. R. G. Ryan
